text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In order to find the greatest challenge 
for Kiseki, I keep moving even in between 
our training sessions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gathering the information I need... and 
asking the person directly if necessary.
choice_data_list:
I want to see all the manga you've drawn 
so far.

I want to see all the manga you've drawn 
up until now.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All of it!? That's way more than a 
gigabyte, you know!?
choice_data_list:
Because what I'm looking for is your 
challenge.

Because what I'm looking for is your 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is Kiseki's challenge and no one 
else's. So I don't want to stray from what 
she "wants to try."
choice_data_list:
I want to make it an exciting challenge 
for you!

I want to make it an exciting challenge 
for you!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Traaaiineer, it's bad manners to use 
your PC while eating.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Once I set my mind on something, I 
tend to get totally absorbed in it~

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Just like me.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer. Since we're here, why 
don't we chat a little more?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"My challenge is all about getting 
everyone excited."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Then first up is you, right beside me! I 
need you to enjoy my challenge more than 
anyone!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe the goal I blurted out about 
'winning a graded race' was kind of 
lacking in impact to begin with, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! If I had a time machine, I'd give the 
past me a stern piece of my mind! Like, 
"Honestly, jeez~~!" Jeeeez~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“From here on out, though, I'm gonna reach 
even higher! Just watch me!”
choice_data_list: —! How high up should we set our sights?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Like winning 2000 races... okay, maybe not 
that many. Becoming an Umamusume who wins 
dozens of races! Or heading out overseas 
to all kinds of countries!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's set a goal so high that your neck 
starts to hurt from looking up at it!
choice_data_list:
Then first, let's become the strongest of 
our generation!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sounds great! "First of all," is 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If that's the case, the presence of the 
'Classic Triple Crown' is huge for the 
Classic division, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In the Classic Triple Crown to decide the 
generation's strongest, there is only one 
race remaining――the final leg.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—I will definitely claim victory in the 
Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our search for Kiseki's next goal isn't 
stopping anytime soon. Both our buoyant 
voices overlap in excitement.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They say the final race of the Classic 
Triple Crown route, the Kikuka Sho, is won 
by "the strongest Umamusume"!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll seize this once-in-a-lifetime chance 
to become the strongest Umamusume. How's 
that sound?!
choice_data_list:
Besides, someone like you won't stop at 
just an ordinary victory!

Besides, someone like you won't stop at 
just an ordinary victory!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha... That's true! Just winning 
wouldn't feel satisfying enough!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If I look even higher up than this—
choice_data_list:
Let's surpass all the past Kikuka Sho 
Umamusume instead!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha, sounds great! Surpassing all 
past Kikuka Sho Umamusume means—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It means I'll create a run that surpasses 
all Triple Tiara Umamusume throughout 
history!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Triple Crown Umamusume. A special title 
granted only to an Umamusume who triumphs 
in the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, 
and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Out of the thousands and hundreds of 
thousands of Umamusume who have debuted 
and run up until now... only seven have 
ever earned that title.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
People speak of their running as if it 
were legendary.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...That looks super duper hard.
choice_data_list:
That future sounds like the most fun of 
all, though!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha, you're way too excited!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —You too, and me too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So what should we do specifically? If 
we're going to 'run an amazing race that 
surpasses all past Kikuka Sho 
Umamusume'...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thinking normally, wouldn't winning by the 
largest possible margin be the most 
straightforward idea?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For now, I'll compile data on all past 
Kikuka Sho races. And then—
choice_data_list: Wait, Kiseki. Let me do some work too.
Wait, Kiseki. Let me do some work too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gathering materials, analyzing data, 
preparing the environment... Those are a 
Trainer's core duties.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If there are resources she needs to create 
the greatest plot possible, I want to 
provide every single one of them.
choice_data_list:
I'll definitely have everything ready 
during the summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh? If it isn't Kitasan, scouting out the 
rivals?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown. An Umamusume from the 
prestigious Satono family who conquered 
races in Hong Kong and the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh... Isn't that Kiseki-san? You're 
not running in the upcoming Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she said she's running in the Kikuka 
Sho. And you know—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—They say they run to get everyone 
excited!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kiseki's next goal is—the Kikuka Sho.
